canonical_hash_policy: canonical JSON hash excludes only manifest_sha256

H06.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H06.fields: SEC Form 4 issuer CIK, owner role, transaction code, shares, price, ownership, amendment
H06.formula: unusual open-market purchase rule; grants/exercises/gifts/amendments excluded
H06.minimum: Form 4 taxonomy, routine history, amendment handling and CIK/ticker identity
H06.universe: PIT equity universe with CIK/ticker continuity
H06.window: one frozen routine-history rule and holding horizon; exact thresholds unspecified by source review

H07.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H07.fields: historical analyst estimate, horizon, analyst/date identity, company identity, revision and publication/vintage
H07.formula: positive revision aggregation and rank; exact horizon/threshold unspecified
H07.minimum: full historical vintages and stale-estimate policy
H07.window: one frozen forecast horizon, rank, cadence and hold

H08.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H08.fields: earnings release time, actual EPS, pre-release consensus, surprise, revisions/restatements, event identity
H08.formula: positive surprise after release with fixed event horizon
H08.minimum: actual/consensus vintages, release timestamps and collision handling
H08.window: one fixed horizon and collision policy; post-2016 holdout required

H09.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H09.fields: customer/supplier link, vintage, direction, identifiers, termination and linked-firm event
H09.formula: customer-to-supplier spillover after fixed lag; direction/hold unspecified
H09.minimum: PIT links, termination and event identifiers
H09.window: one link source, event mapping, lag and hold

H10.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H10.fields: original 10-K/10-Q versions, CIK, section text, accession and acceptance
H10.formula: text change versus prior filing; direction frozen ex ante
H10.minimum: original versions, text normalization, sections and CIK continuity
H10.window: one pair/version rule, section vocabulary and cadence

H11.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H11.fields: fund flow, holdings vintage, fund identity, ownership weight and publication
H11.formula: flow multiplied by pre-known ownership pressure; buy-after-pressure direction must be frozen
H11.minimum: PIT holdings/flows, rebalance events and capacity
H11.universe: PIT equity universe covered by fund holdings
H11.window: one lag, pressure aggregation, hold, capacity and collision rule

H12.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H12.fields: named index, methodology/membership vintage, announcement and implementation timestamps
H12.formula: index addition/removal pressure; direction/hold frozen before outcomes
H12.freeze_rationale: The authoritative queue leaves the index unspecified; NYSE Composite is frozen pre-outcome because the cited official NYSE methodology is public and defines announcement/effective distinctions. Membership history remains unacquired.
H12.minimum: PIT membership, methodology versions and corporate actions
H12.window: one index/vintage, event window and execution rule

H13.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H13.execution: explicit opening/closing auction or next-bar semantics
H13.fields: raw/adjusted intraday quotes or trades, session/auction calendar and executable open/close
H13.formula: overnight/intraday split using transaction/VWAP-style construction; daily OHLC proxy forbidden
H13.minimum: intraday SIP/live parity and executable fills
H13.universe: PIT equity universe with SIP/live feed parity
H13.window: one session split and exact fill model

H15.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H15.fields: cash deal terms, target identity, amendments, announcement/close/cancel/break/delist events
H15.formula: cash-only merger spread with fixed entry/exit/cancel rules
H15.minimum: terms, amendments, terminal events and identity lifecycle
H15.window: one event source, lifecycle policy and cash ledger

H16.controls: incumbent, isolated candidate, passive/cash, matched exposure and shared-capital diagnostic
H16.fields: two-step spinoff announcement/effective date, distribution, ownership conversion, successor IDs and lifecycle
H16.formula: narrow two-step ownership-conversion mechanism; direction unspecified
H16.minimum: events, distributions, successor mapping and adjusted lifecycle
H16.window: one event taxonomy, successor rule and hold
